items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: I've seen references to it, but I don't really know.

ctx.x: the first thing I did with Louis, and then we did "High Society", and the next one we did was the Red Nichols story of Five Pennies. And then he did something else, "The Beat Generation". It was a sad -- was a bad movie. I don't know what it was about. And he did something like that.

But those were the ones I did with him over there. Of course, the first movie I did was with Lincelford in about '38, and this was that "Blues in the Night" movie with Jack -- what's his name? Was it Jack Carson? I think it was Jack Carson. It's way back.
I've seen references to it, but I don't really know. It was a feature-length movie, right?
